authority: GOVERNANCE.md and CONTRIBUTING.md: a responsible human maintainer records scope approval. Labels, recommendations and silence are not authorization. GitHub Triage access is not a per-label ACL.

human_decisions.status/needs-triage: Awaiting a human scope decision, even after automated advice.
human_decisions.status/needs-design: Design discussion is required before implementation.
human_decisions.status/accepted: Communicates human approval; the issue's human approval record is authoritative.
human_decisions.status/deferred: Not invited for implementation now; never equivalent to accepted.

classification_policy: Optional, useful classification only. No mandatory five-axis taxonomy. Add only existing allowlisted labels to empty dimensions; preserve human choices and discuss conflicts in the comment.

processing.meaning: Advisory processing and deduplication only, never human acceptance.

legacy_policy: Aliases are read compatibility, not migrations or proof of approval. Do not infer deferred versus accepted from historic bot labels. Preserve unknown labels; malformed and ambiguous names require human review. Shepherd status labels remain separate processing metadata.
rollout: Phase 2 is compatibility mode. Do not create, rename or delete live labels or milestones, and do not migrate issues.
Read both completed-advice markers but write only the existing active_write_reviewed label. triage/recommended is deliberately absent from the workflow add-labels allowlist.

Read repository label definitions before any emission. If active_write_reviewed is missing or unreadable, stop with an actionable run-log error; do not create it or emit repeated advisory comments without durable deduplication.

Before a later rollout, a maintainer must separately approve and provision canonical processing labels and status/deferred, then change active_write_reviewed and the workflow allowlist together and recompile.

Keep both reviewed markers in read filters during rollout. Preserve legacy markers until separately approved migration and rollback have been checked. Never remove status/needs-triage when an advisory completes.
triage/requested is the canonical advisory request. Until provisioned, use manual dispatch or the legacy status/needs-triage labeled event. The legacy human decision label is not consumed.
Paginate oldest-first past skipped, reviewed and per-author-quota items until the eligible batch is full or candidates are exhausted. Never stop at an all-skipped first page.
